source_report.file: 室外三维仿真环境构建仓库_近期论文补充调研_20261107.docx

policy: Keep manuscript snapshot data unchanged. Merge this independently curated collection when rendering; deduplicate stable paper IDs across collections. Game/indoor/runtime-only examples remain separately scoped. Published code links require actual implementation, not a placeholder repository.

papers.name: OctWorld
papers.title: OctWorld: Long-Range World-Consistent Video Generation with Octree-Based 3D Mapping
papers.selection_basis: November 2026 research supplement; individually checked primary sources
papers.persistent_state: Octree TSDF map
papers.summary: Fuses generated RGB-D into an extensible octree TSDF memory for consistent exploration and revisits.
papers.evidence_scope: Rendering and spatial consistency; collision geometry and controller outcomes are not established.

papers.name: L3G-World
papers.title: L3G-World: Real-Time Infinite World Generation with Latent 3D Gaussian Memory
papers.selection_basis: November 2026 research supplement; individually checked primary sources
papers.persistent_state: Latent 3D Gaussians
papers.summary: Alternates video generation with updates to persistent latent Gaussian memory.
papers.evidence_scope: Latent spatial memory does not establish exportable collision assets or physical interaction.

papers.name: Drive2Gauss
papers.title: Drive2Gauss: FeedForward 4D Gaussian Reconstruction from Multimodal Generative Driving Videos
papers.selection_basis: November 2026 research supplement; individually checked primary sources
papers.persistent_state: Dynamic 4D Gaussians
papers.summary: Converts jointly generated driving RGB, metric depth and flow into reusable dynamic Gaussian scenes.
papers.evidence_scope: Reconstruction quality is measured against generated observations; planner or physics benefits are not established.

papers.name: BuildRome
papers.title: Building Rome from a Single Image
papers.selection_basis: November 2026 research supplement; individually checked primary sources
papers.persistent_state: Exportable triangle mesh
papers.summary: Recovers complete indoor/outdoor scene meshes from a single reference image using adaptive spatial chunks.
papers.evidence_scope: Mesh export is supported; estimated scale, collision proxies and navigation structures need separate validation.
papers.license_note: Original code and fine-tuned weights: CC BY-NC 4.0; upstream components have separate terms.

papers.name: DistScene
papers.title: DistScene: Object-to-Scene Distillation for 3D Scene Generation
papers.selection_basis: November 2026 research supplement; individually checked primary sources
papers.persistent_state: Environment and object geometry in shared coordinates
papers.summary: Uses object-to-scene distillation and local refinement to recover compositional scenes from an image.
papers.evidence_scope: Includes outdoor reconstruction evaluation; physically checked training compositions do not establish physical validity of outputs.

papers.name: RECAST
papers.title: RECAST: From Log Replay to Closed-Loop Driving Simulation with View-Complete Actors
papers.selection_basis: November 2026 research supplement; individually checked primary sources
papers.persistent_state: View-complete Gaussian actors registered in a driving scene
papers.summary: Completes partially observed vehicle actors and registers them in reconstructed scenes for planner-in-the-loop simulation.
papers.evidence_scope: Closed-loop results concern GTRS-Dense in controlled ego–actor interactions; distinct from Recast Navigation.

papers.name: Foundation4D
papers.title: Foundation4D: Towards a unified perception and reconstruction model for autonomous vehicles
papers.selection_basis: November 2026 research supplement; individually checked primary sources
papers.persistent_state: Geometry, tracks, occupancy and Gaussian scenes
papers.summary: Jointly recovers driving-scene structure and supplies geometry and actor priors to LiDAR-free NuRec.
papers.evidence_scope: Downstream reconstruction still uses GPS/IMU; training annotations use LiDAR. Data release does not establish model-code release.

papers.name: OpenFlyScan
papers.title: OpenFlyScan: A Quality-Guided Aerial Reconstruction System for Consumer Drones
papers.selection_basis: November 2026 research supplement; individually checked primary sources
papers.persistent_state: Joint aerial reconstruction from initial and additional observations
papers.summary: Predicts regional reconstruction quality and plans targeted drone reacquisition before joint reconstruction.
papers.evidence_scope: Field acquisition and reconstruction are demonstrated; full teacher/cache training resources remain incomplete.

papers.name: SkyAnchor
papers.title: SkyAnchor: Updating Metric-scale Aerial 3D Gaussian Scenes from Unposed Ground-View Sequences
papers.selection_basis: November 2026 research supplement; individually checked primary sources
papers.persistent_state: Metric-scale aerial–ground Gaussian scene
papers.summary: Registers later unposed ground sequences against an existing metric aerial scaffold and fuses scene updates.
papers.evidence_scope: Requires an existing metric aerial SfM/Gaussian anchor; updates measurements of the same real place.

papers.name: VDGS
papers.title: VDGS: Visibility-Driven Large-Scale 3D Gaussian Splatting for Aerial Scene Reconstruction
papers.selection_basis: November 2026 research supplement; individually checked primary sources
papers.persistent_state: Partitioned aerial Gaussian scene
papers.summary: Uses visibility statistics for partitioning and gradient compensation in large aerial reconstructions.
papers.evidence_scope: Evidence concerns reconstruction quality and scalability, rather than navigation or physical interaction.

papers.name: ReconDreamer#
papers.title: ReconDreamer#: Self-Evolving Closed-Loop Synergy of Reconstruction and Generation for Dynamic Driving Scenes
papers.selection_basis: November 2026 research supplement; individually checked primary sources
papers.persistent_state: Dynamic driving-scene representation
papers.summary: Iteratively improves generation and reconstruction with an adaptive geometry-prior ground model.
papers.evidence_scope: Closed loop refers to reconstruction–generation refinement, rather than a planner/controller loop. This is a separate paper ID.

papers.name: OccSplat
papers.title: Quo Vadis, Driving Scene Reconstruction? Occlusion-Aware Gaussian Densification
papers.selection_basis: November 2026 research supplement; individually checked primary sources
papers.persistent_state: Gaussian primitives added to occluded regions
papers.summary: Maps unsupported occluded regions and completes them by adding persistent Gaussian primitives.
papers.evidence_scope: Completes the 3D representation rather than only rendered pixels; inferred unseen geometry is not measurement ground truth.

papers.name: PointForward V2
papers.title: PointForward V2: Point-Aligned Interaction for Feedforward Driving Reconstruction
papers.selection_basis: November 2026 research supplement; individually checked primary sources
papers.persistent_state: Static and object-aligned dynamic scene representation
papers.summary: Uses compact static and dynamic registers for point-aligned interaction across views and times.
papers.evidence_scope: Verified at abstract level; V2 code availability is not inherited from PointForward.

papers.name: TerrainForge
papers.title: TerrainForge: Physics-Grounded Road Geometry Editing for Counterfactual Autonomous Driving
papers.selection_basis: November 2026 research supplement; individually checked primary sources
papers.persistent_state: Edited road geometry, friction and dependent vehicle state
papers.summary: Propagates road-shape and friction edits through vehicle dynamics, camera viewpoint and inter-vehicle clearance.
papers.evidence_scope: Physics is compared with CarSim in specified settings; no unrelated procedural-terrain repository is linked.

papers.name: IGSW
papers.title: IGSW: Multi-Weather Urban Scene Reconstruction with Intrinsic-Decoupled Gaussian Splatting
papers.selection_basis: November 2026 research supplement; individually checked primary sources
papers.persistent_state: Intrinsic-decoupled multi-weather 4D Gaussians
papers.summary: Separates shared scene structure from weather-dependent appearance and rejects unreliable teacher regions.
papers.evidence_scope: Weather appearance control does not establish corresponding friction, wind or other physical-property changes.

papers.name: Code4Scene
papers.title: Code4Scene: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Constructing and Editing 3D Scenes
papers.selection_basis: November 2026 research supplement; individually checked primary sources
papers.persistent_state: Engine-native scenes and evaluation artifacts
papers.summary: Benchmarks construction and editing of persistent Unreal scenes, including validity and preservation of non-target content.
papers.evidence_scope: Includes outdoor scenes. Runtime route execution is controller-specific; external scene assets are obtained separately.
papers.role: Benchmarks Unreal scene construction/editing, artifact integrity, static validity, non-target preservation and controller-specific route execution; third-party assets obtained separately.

papers.name: Visibility-Aware Reference
papers.title: Visibility-Aware Reference Generation for Benchmarking Visual 3D Reconstruction in Vegetation-Rich Environments
papers.selection_basis: November 2026 research supplement; individually checked primary sources
papers.persistent_state: Visibility-filtered depth and reference point clouds
papers.summary: Builds camera-visible geometric references from images, LiDAR and poses for vegetation-rich outdoor evaluation.
papers.evidence_scope: Evaluates reference coverage and reconstruction; does not generate an interactive simulation world.
papers.role: Generates camera-visible depth and reference clouds from images, LiDAR and poses for reconstruction evaluation in vegetation-rich environments.

papers.name: Drive3R
papers.title: Drive3R: Block-wise Streaming Geometric Foundation Models for Autonomous Driving

papers.persistent_state: World-frame points and camera poses
papers.summary: Streams long driving sequences through block-wise geometry estimation with confidence-aware re-anchoring.
papers.evidence_scope: A driving-specific geometric support method; not a complete simulator or physical scene package.

papers.name: MCSplat
papers.title: MCSplat: Multi-View Photometric and Geometric Consistent Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting for Driving Scenes
papers.selection_basis: November 2026 research supplement; individually checked primary sources
papers.persistent_state: Multi-camera-consistent driving Gaussians
papers.summary: Separates camera-specific appearance from canonical scene appearance to reduce geometric artifacts.
papers.evidence_scope: Evidence concerns geometry and rendering consistency; simulator physics is not established.

papers.name: LangStreet

papers.persistent_state: Persistent anchor/slot language fields

papers.name: World from Motion

papers.reason: Game-world evidence in Craftium/OpenWorldCreative; retained as a scoped mechanism reference.
